source_name: EU Publications Office - public procurement notice detail pages (SI)
why_relevant: Per-notice permalink pages for SI procurements (observed for Ljubljana data-network maintenance, Celje transport, etc.) - stable, citable archive records with CPV codes, usable as evidence anchors for individual award findings.

source_name: Publications Office — public procurement / procurement-details pages (op.europa.eu)
why_relevant: Publications Office renders individual EU procurement records with buyer, CPV, award method, estimated and final contract value. A confirmed Slovenian banking-services example was found here (Aerodrom/Brnik, CPV 66110000, awarded to SKB d.d.), demonstrating it as a usable secondary rendering of TED data with clean value fields.

source_name: IUS-INFO – KPK annual report and procurement legal commentary
why_relevant: Hosts parliamentary attachments such as the KPK annual report (LETNO POROČILO) and legal commentary on procurement review. Useful as a secondary retrieval path when the primary institutional link has moved.

source_name: Banca Intesa (RS) – Portal dobavljača / Suppliers page (local-subsidiary pattern exemplar)
why_relevant: Shows how an Intesa CEE subsidiary surfaces the group supplier portal on its own local site — strong template for locating/expecting the equivalent page on intesasanpaolobank.si, and useful for cross-border vendor-onboarding comparison.

source_name: BidDetail - Slovenia tenders
why_relevant: Another TendersInfo-class reseller listing SI eProcurement/eTender opportunities; useful only as a triangulation check that a notice exists and as a cross-source coverage benchmark.

source_name: Bidovate - Slovenia procurement aggregation
why_relevant: EU-focused aggregator with a dedicated Slovenia source page merging SI notices into one searchable interface; another reseller layer over the national portal/TED worth benchmarking for archive depth.

source_name: Commercial IFI-tender aggregators (TendersOnTime, TendersInfo, GlobalTenders) - EBRD/EIB/World Bank feeds
why_relevant: Third-party aggregators re-publish IFI notices with their own indexing and often retain notices after the issuing body removes them, which makes them useful for historical reconstruction and for cross-checking that an IFI channel was not missed. They are not authoritative and are paywalled beyond teaser level, so they should be used as a discovery/QA aid only, never as a primary record.

source_name: Commercial TED aggregators (TenderWolf, TenderMetric, TenderDetail, TenderRadar)
why_relevant: Re-publishers of TED data with CPV- and country-scoped landing pages (e.g. a Slovenia EU-tenders page and a CPV 66110000 banking-services page). Valuable mainly as discovery aids and as sanity checks on CPV coverage; not a substitute for the official feed and subject to paywalls.

source_name: European Commission Representation in Slovenia - Razpisi za financiranje v EU
why_relevant: A Slovenian-language aggregation layer maintained by the Commission's national representation, pointing to EU-level funding calls (including centrally managed programmes such as Digital Europe) as they are relevant to Slovenian applicants. Useful as a cross-check that no EU-financed call channel touching SI financial services has been missed, and as a source of the canonical Slovenian terminology for EU funding instruments.

source_name: fabiodisconzi.com open-TED - CPV/country notice indexes for Slovenia
why_relevant: Independent static mirror/archive of TED notices indexed by year, CPV and country - a ready-made SI-by-CPV browse path (the example is CPV 72312100 data-preparation services). Useful for rapid CPV-scoped reconnaissance and as a fallback when TED's own UI is awkward; freshness and completeness unverified.

source_name: GlobalTenders - Slovenia government tenders and contract awards
why_relevant: Reseller exposing SI contract awards with contractor names and bid amounts - occasionally surfaces award detail that is hard to reach in the SI portal UI. Treat as lead-generation, always re-verify against TED or the national portal.

source_name: Kapitalska družba (KAD) — Javna naročila in oddaja nepremičnin
why_relevant: KAD manages the demographic reserve fund and pension-company assets (SKD 65.300); it buys asset-management, custody, reporting and IT services. Its page states that all javna naročila are published on the Portal javnih naročil, so it functions primarily as a routing pointer, while own-site PDFs carry javna zbiranja ponudb (e.g. asset/real-estate offers).

source_name: Law Insider – Slovenian 'razpisna dokumentacija' contract corpus
why_relevant: Third-party archive of Slovenian tender documentation and contract templates. Repeatedly surfaced for bank-procurement queries; useful for reconstructing standard Slovenian razpisna dokumentacija clauses, qualification conditions and pricing structures that private banks also mirror.

source_name: Racunovodja.com — accounting/legal professional publication
why_relevant: Publishes plain-language explainers of procurement regulation (e.g. Uredba o finančnih zavarovanjih pri javnem naročanju) — supplies the legal vocabulary and rule changes needed to interpret award notices.

source_name: SBCA – Slovenian Blockchain Association / Slovensko blockchain združenje
why_relevant: Second Slovenian blockchain/crypto association; useful for completing the crypto-payments actor universe and for cross-referencing with Blockchain Alliance membership.

source_name: Tax-Fin-Lex – Zbirka sodne prakse (commercial legal database)
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator that indexes DKOM decisions and court practice with editorial abstracts (jedro, institut, pravna podlaga). Its indexing can surface procurement-review material that is hard to find via the official search, but it is paywalled.

source_name: Tender Impulse - Slovenia tenders
why_relevant: Reseller aggregating SI e-procurement portals and government sites, with date-sliced list pages that act as a crude daily archive; also offers bid consultancy, which signals which SI opportunity types attract foreign bidders.

source_name: TendersInfo - Slovenia tenders and contract awards
why_relevant: Classic TendersInfo-type reseller (the archetype named in this cell). Claims daily aggregation from thousands of government sources plus a separate Slovenia contract-awards view and some private tenders. Value is breadth and the awards archive; quality/freshness needs verification.

source_name: TendersOnTime / TendersTech - Slovenia notices and contract awards
why_relevant: Reseller family exposing SI contract-award pages and individually addressable notice records (e.g. an 'Information systems' contract notice in Slovenia), giving another route to award detail when the national portal has purged the listing.

source_name: Trite.si - Javna naročila (MORS/DRSI notification service)
why_relevant: Niche SI notification service focused on specific contracting authorities. Low direct banking relevance but demonstrates the buyer-scoped alert model and is a POINTER to how small SI resellers slice the national portal feed.

source_name: Žurnal24 — popular daily (banking IT incident reporting)
why_relevant: Covers customer-visible failures of bank core-system migrations (e.g. BKS Bank information-system problems) — such incidents reveal which vendor/system a private bank actually switched to.
